title: Near-Field Communications: A Comprehensive Survey
domain: Near-field communications (fundamentals, models, performance, signal processing, applications)

analysis_policy.exclude_scope: References, author bios/photos, acknowledgments, appendix, nomenclature
analysis_policy.notes: Acronym/glossary tables treated as nomenclature; page markers ignored.

section_flow.objective: Summarize key takeaways and restate the NFC research roadmap.
notable_moves: Keeps the conclusion minimal, pointing back to research opportunities.

evidence_locators.claim: Restates NFC roadmap and calls for future research.

hook.evidence: Leads with 5G-to-NG shift and plane-vs-spherical wave contrast plus Fraunhofer distance math.

gap.evidence: Notes existing magazines/tutorials and case-study surveys do not comprehensively cover NFC history, models, performance, and applications together.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges prior magazines/tutorials and then argues missing pieces like comparative math tools and full application coverage.

contribution.evidence: Five contribution bullets span principles, models, performance, processing, and integration.

organization.evidence: Provides section-by-section roadmap and references an organization figure.

scope_boundary.evidence: Defines NFC as radiating near-field driven by ELAAs/high frequencies and excludes reactive-NF RFID focus.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: We redefine NFC via spherical-wave physics, review models/metrics/processing, compare against prior magazines/tutorials, and organize as fundamentals → models → performance → processing → applications → conclusion.

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Intro packs a timeline and comparison table to anchor the hook/gap; organization figure early to orient; tables scattered for milestones, comparisons, acronyms; figures throughout fundamentals/model/performance sections to visualize wave regions and architectures.

figures.evidence_locator: Table I and associated timeline visuals in Introduction
Organization figure referenced near Section E

tables.evidence_locator: Table I timeline of NFC milestones
Table II comparison with existing works

lesson_blocks.lesson: Combine physics hook, literature gap, and contributions with embedded timeline and comparison table.
Bridge physics-to-communications and antenna evolution before heavier math.
Matrix SPD/CAP by LoS/NLoS and flag non-stationarity before diving into submodels.
Use a three-metric backbone (DoF, scaling, rate) with short outlook to prevent math fatigue.
Triad pattern (estimation, beamforming, training) capped with an outlook to applications.

synthesis.aha_moment: A consistent matrix—physics to antenna to SPD/CAP models to three performance metrics to three processing blocks—keeps an equation-heavy NFC survey readable while grounding every section back to the near-field transition story.

methodology.selection_criteria: Curated NFC literature across physics, modeling, performance, processing, and applications; no explicit database filters listed.

style.section_openers_pattern: Forward-looking opener plus mini-map of upcoming subsections.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Physics hook + gap + contribution bundle
steps: Open with a physics contrast (plane vs spherical, Fraunhofer distance) to anchor novelty.
Position the literature gap with a quick magazine/tutorial/survey scan.
List contributions and pair with an organization map plus timeline/comparison visuals.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Combines technical authority with fast reader orientation and clear promises.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Physics-to-communications bridge
steps: Start with physical model categories and constraints.
Transition to antenna evolution and design implications.
Close with a light theoretical primer (e.g., EMIT) without heavy math.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Prepares readers for later math by grounding abstractions in physical intuition.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Model matrix with non-stationarity flag
steps: Declare axes (e.g., SPD vs CAP; LoS vs NLoS vs hybrid).
Survey each cell with concise modeling notes and assumptions.
Call out spatial non-stationarity early and revisit per model family.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: A clear matrix keeps diverse channel models organized and comparable.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Three-metric performance backbone
steps: Define three metrics (DoF/EDoF, power scaling, rate) up front.
For each, summarize key results, tools, and sensitivities.
Finish with a brief outlook tying metrics back to models.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Fixing on three metrics keeps a math-heavy section skimmable and comparable.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Signal-processing triad with outlook
steps: Use a fixed triad: estimation, beamforming, training.
End with an outlook paragraph to bridge into applications.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: A repeated triad plus outlook prevents drift and sets up application narratives cleanly.

conversion_noise: Special characters in tables and equations

notes: Heavily mathematical sections with many equations; counts are heuristic. References excluded starting at References heading.
